mapper.update: UPDATE t_mp_factory_param mfp JOIN t_mp_production_mode_param pmp ON mfp.PARAM_CODE = pmp.PARAM_CODE AND mfp.FACTORY_CODE = pmp.FACTORY_CODE AND mfp.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE = pmp.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE SET mfp.PARAM_VALUE = pmp.PARAM_VALUE WHERE mfp.IS_DELETE = 0 AND mfp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mfp.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE = #{productTypeCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
